scope: Normalized Chevrolet Suburban exterior color audit for model years 1935 through 1942, 1946 through 1962, 1964 through 1968, and 2006. Exact body style, series, regular paint, special equipment paint, market, source revision, and secondary evidence scopes remain separate.

audit_method.strict_scope_rule: A color is not assigned to the Chevrolet Suburban unless the source prints an exact Suburban scope. Truck, panel, Carryall variant, GMC, Tahoe, and adjacent year palettes are excluded unless the exact Chevrolet Suburban scope is printed.
audit_method.historical_source_review: Every page of each retained official GM kit was searched and visually reviewed. Empty color arrays are explicit no chart results, not inferred unavailability.
audit_method.market_rule: Canada and United States evidence remain separate.
audit_method.normalization_rule: Sources, year findings, evidence scopes, and color records are separate tables linked by source_id, year, and scope_id.

sources.title: 2006 Chevrolet Tahoe Vehicle Information Kit
sources.revision: 2006 Tahoe restoration kit; no printed revision date governs Suburban colors.
sources.review_scope: Every PDF page, with full text search and visual review of candidate color sections.
sources.evidence_limit: The only exact Suburban mention is a suspension statement on PDF page 36. The regular, Z71, police, special service, and SEO paint sections are printed as Chevrolet Truck Tahoe material. None is promoted to Suburban availability.

sources.title: 2006 Chevrolet Tahoe and Suburban Canadian Sales Brochure
sources.revision: Printed in Canada, August 2005.
sources.review_scope: Complete brochure review, with original resolution visual review of PDF pages 26 and 27.
sources.evidence_limit: The palette is an exact Tahoe and Suburban Canadian brochure scope. It is not proof of United States availability. The brochure directs buyers to a sales consultant for exact model availability.

sources.title: 2006 Chevrolet Suburban 2500 Commercial 2WD, New Jersey Purchase Bureau Section 7
sources.review_scope: All 36 pages, including visual review of the printed color availability chart on PDF page 25.
sources.evidence_limit: Exact only for model CC25906, 4dr 2500 2WD Commercial. It does not establish every Suburban series, drivetrain, trim, or retail configuration.

sources.title: 2006 Chevrolet Suburban 1500 Colors
sources.review_scope: Complete retained HTML and embedded color data for the selected 2006 Chevrolet Suburban 1500 page.
sources.evidence_limit: Secondary union of displayed color names. The page does not preserve a complete factory code, trim, package, body style, or revision mapping, so this evidence is corroboration only.
